preconditions.description: The number of destinations is between 2 and 10^5.
The number of corridors is between n - 1 and 10^6.
The destinations a and b are within the range of 1 to n.
The destinations a and b are different.
The energy e for each corridor is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The maximum energy E_max(c_1) for the first corridor c_1 is an integer.

invariants.description: The graph representing the Time Corridors is connected, meaning there is a path between any two destinations.

invariants.expression: The graph does not contain self-loops or multiple edges
invariants.description: The graph does not contain any self-loops (edges where both ends are the same destination) or multiple edges (more than one edge between the same pair of destinations).
